scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a finite reflecting interval and a uniformly positive freely diffusing gap between consecutive pulses.
A uniform initial spatial law is used; the result is not claimed for unbounded geometries or accumulating pulse times.
The single-pulse envelope constants are not asserted numerically sharp, although the infinite-horizon convergence threshold is exact.
A broader prior theorem on time-dependent boundary killing might imply the result; this remains a publication-priority risk.
title: A sharp exposure criterion for periodically pulsed Robin absorption
